title: 已完结热门小说推荐
content:
第一次开会，内容很简单，老师大致交代了后半个学期的一些安排，关于外出集训、听讲座、参加各类活动竞赛的事宜。许则坐在中间一排，看着大屏幕，但过程中总是不自觉垂下眼，望着前排座位出神——不过每次也只发一两秒的呆，他很快会回过神，重新看向讲台。结束前，老师将行程表发下来，活动大部分由学校出资组织，剩下一部分需要自费。顺着日期一行行字往下看，在看到自费活动后面跟着的价格时，许则的目光顿了顿，随后他把表格对折，放进校服口袋里。其他人陆陆续续离开会议室，老师在收拾东西，许则站起来，迈下台阶，走到讲台边。“有什么问题吗？”老师问。“老师，每个活动都必须参加吗？”“没有强制性要求，但建议都参加，对之后的录取方向和专业选择会有帮助。”与此同时，陆赫扬和贺蔚正往门边走，两人听见老师问了句：“是有什么不方便吗？”讲台前的alpha站得很直，顿了一秒，他说：“我想申请不参加。”陆赫扬抬眼，恰好看见许则的侧脸，片刻后，他从许则身后路过。贺蔚搭着陆赫扬的肩，很难讲贺少爷到底是不知人间疾苦还是在感叹，总之他低笑着自问自答说：“是有什么不方便吗？有啊~钞票不方便。”下午最后一节是游泳课，许则从更衣室出来，池嘉寒正站在泳池边热身，他是九班的，九班和十一班的游泳课从高二开始就是同一节。“能下水吗？”池嘉寒看了眼许则肋骨上的伤，多少有些担心。“没事。”“有事你也不会说的。”池嘉寒高高地抻长手臂，随口道，“刚刚我听见体育老师说你们班下周起游泳课换到星期二了。”许则对此并不关心，但他还是问：“为什么？”“就是调课吧，之后你们就跟一班……还有哪几个班我忘了，一起上课。”许则一怔，随后很慢地把投在深蓝色泳池里的目光转到池嘉寒脸上：“一班？”“嗯，应该是的。”察觉许则的注意力忽然有了明显的集中，池嘉寒扭过头问，“怎么了？”许则摇了一下头：“没什么。”哨声响起，两人各自回到alpha和omega的队伍里，体育老师开始安排训练任务，完成的人可以提早下课。池嘉寒是游泳苦手，以往许则都会在任务达标后来监督他训练，但今天许则训练完从水里上来，池嘉寒发现他的伤口已经泛白。体育老师做好数据记录，抬头看了许则一眼，表情有些犹豫，最终还是什么都没说，让他下课了。毕竟许则身上的伤向来层出不穷，向他询问也总是无果，预备校的老师又严格遵循不干涉学生私生活的准则，久而久之，便只能报以视若无睹的态度。有omega跑到许则面前，对他说了什么，许则只低头看了看，接着摇摇头。用膝盖想都知道他肯定又在说‘没事’，池嘉寒爬上岸，走过去推着许则往座椅边走，让他坐下，从一旁的公用药箱里拿了碘伏棉签帮他消毒。许则一路都没怎么反抗，只说：“已经愈合了，不会感染的。”池嘉寒几乎要被他气笑：“不会感染，但那些omega会心疼。”许则在这方面一直迟钝得可以——又或是从没留意过。他皱起眉：“什么？”“没什么，等会儿你不要下水了，我自己练，你早点放学休息。”“你会被留堂的。”许则对池嘉寒的游泳水平很清楚。池嘉寒噎了下，才说：“我最近进步了，能按时完成训练的。”“没事，走吧。”许则随手抽了张纱布按在伤口上，站起来，“我在岸边看着你。”回到泳池边，气氛似乎有所不同，池嘉寒往前看，见有个迟到了半节课的alpha正站在隔壁池边，身旁围着不少omega。体育老师掐着秒表吹哨，alpha干脆地入了水——池嘉寒怀疑他的入水位置就够自己游好几秒的了。“贺蔚，s级，上星期转来的，今天刚来上课。”池嘉寒说，“跟陆赫扬关系很好。”陆赫扬的背景一直是个谜，鲜少人知道，而贺蔚是个转学进来不过半天的生面孔，在来预备校前没被透露出任何风声，两人走在一起，多少有些耐人寻味——在预备校里，个人信息能完全保密不被查到半点的，通常值得深思。在池嘉寒看来，就算全校人都在猜，许则也不会是其中之一。他好像游离在所有人之外，对任何事都漠不关心——沉默寡言，不社交不娱乐，你不知道他在乎什么，喜欢什么，有什么欲望，如果他脑袋上的那张脸长得再普通一些，完全会是淹没在校园里籍籍无名的一位。不过池嘉寒还是觉得，作为朋友，有义务向许则稍稍科普些人际知识，即便许则绝不可能主动惹事，但在预备校里，多了解一点总是不会错的。

许则看着那头的泳池，“嗯”了一声，如同往常一样，没发表任何意见。池嘉寒确实进步了，在下课前五分钟完成了今天的训练指标，同时，贺蔚则是在十五分钟内结束了所有训练任务。回到更衣室，贺蔚冲了个澡，出来时陆赫扬正坐在储物柜前的椅子上看手机。听到脚步声，他抬起头：“好了？”“好了，辛苦陆公子专程来这儿等我。走，吃饭去了。”两人顺着更衣室和浴室之间的长廊往外走，路过第四号更衣室门口时，里面忽然走出来一个alpha，身上穿了件洗到有些磨毛发白的黑T，头发半湿，发尾上的水珠沿着白皙的后颈滚进领口里。许则低着头停在更衣室门口，扣手环，顺便给正在往外走的两个alpha让路。不料那两人却并没有从他面前路过，许则听见有人叫他的名字，并且是以那种，一字一句的叫法。“许、则。”这语气听起来像是来堵人的，许则面无表情地抬起头，冷冷看过去，却瞬间怔了怔。贺蔚正勾着嘴角朝他笑：“老师跟我说，你今天的训练成绩是所有alpha里最好的，你平常喜欢游泳？”明明是贺蔚在问他问题，许则的目光却首先落在陆赫扬脸上。在撞上那道陌生又平静的视线时，许则的手指无意识蜷缩了一下，手环掉在了地上。“不喜欢。”许则回过神，俯身去捡手环，低声回答。“那说明你天赋好，下星期游泳课刚好是期中考，我们比一场？”许则继续扣他的手环，但不知怎的，始终扣不准，最后他干脆放弃，手垂下去，说：“我们班游泳课以后调到周二。”“周二？”贺蔚想了一秒，转头问陆赫扬，“你们一班的游泳课好像是在周二来着？”“嗯。”陆赫扬应了声。“那也巧，你俩可以比比看。”贺蔚这人好像不挑点事就会无聊死。陆赫扬没搭话，不怎么在意的样子。他看了眼手机：“顾昀迟说他到了，催我们过去。”“啧，他的耐性什么时候能好一点，走了走了。”贺蔚搭住陆赫扬的肩往前走，路过许则面前时，他顺口道，“你的手环换个吧，太旧了，所以才这么难扣。”许则微微低着头，没作答，等他们走后，他再次拿起手环。走廊光线昏暗，许则戴了足足有半分钟，才把手环扣好。他将书包挂到左肩，往外走，一滴水珠顺着刘海落下来，流进右眼，视野顿时模糊了一半，许则抬手擦了下眼睛。不知道为什么，他觉得有些懊恼。“你想干什么。”去停车场的路上，陆赫扬忽然问。贺蔚装傻：“什么干什么？”陆赫扬看他一眼。“你说许则啊？”贺蔚笑了笑，“我又没干嘛，聊两句怎么了。”“为什么提换手环的事。”“真的没恶意，就随口一提，没想那么多。”贺蔚转着车钥匙，“我堂妹，以前在预备校初中部的，去年转学走了，你知道吧？”“知道。”“这小孩，初三的时候跟我哭诉说她向一个学长告白被拒绝了，今天听到许则的名字我才想起来，他就是那个学长。”贺蔚说着，坐上驾驶座，“所以，我好奇嘛。”“以后别那么无聊了。”陆赫扬说。贺蔚的优点之一是充满好奇心，缺点是他的好奇心从来不用在该用的地方。“都是alpha，你别弄得好像我欺负他一样。”贺蔚发动车子，“他好歹是个s级啊。”陆赫扬淡淡道：“怕你惹事。”“怎么会，我这人最安分了。”贺蔚大言不惭，“倒是你，我感觉许则好像很怕你，被你看一眼，手环都掉地上了。”他说完还问陆赫扬：“你发现了吗？”陆赫扬摘下手环，勾在手指上掂了掂，回答：“没发现。”
content_en:
The first meeting was very simple. The teacher roughly explained some arrangements for the second half of the semester, including going out for training, listening to lectures, and participating in various activities and competitions.Xu Ze sat in the middle row and looked at the big screen, but during the process he always lowered his eyes unconsciously and stared at the seats in the front row in trance - but he was only dazed for a second or two each time. He would soon come back to his senses and look at the podium again.Before the end, the teacher sent out the schedule. Most of the activities were funded by the school, and the remaining part needed to be paid for at one's own expense.Looking down the lines of the date, Xu Ze paused when he saw the price followed by the self-funded activities. Then he folded the form in half and put it in his school uniform pocket.Others left the conference room one after another. The teacher was packing things, and Xu stood up, walked down the steps, and walked to the podium."Is there any problem?" the teacher asked."Teacher, do you have to participate in every activity?" "There is no mandatory requirement, but it is recommended that you participate. It will be helpful for future admissions and major choices." At the same time, Lu Heyang and He Wei were walking towards the door. They heard the teacher ask: "Is there any inconvenience?" The alpha in front of the podium stood up straight, paused for a second, and said, "I want to apply not to participate." Lu Heyang raised his eyes and happened to see Xu Ze's profile. After a moment, he passed behind Xu Ze.He Wei put his arm on Lu Heyang's shoulder. It was hard to tell whether Master He was ignorant of the sufferings of the world or just lamenting. In short, he smiled and asked himself: "Is there any inconvenience? Yes~ money is inconvenient." The last session in the afternoon was swimming class. Xu Ze came out of the locker room. Chi Jiahan was standing by the pool to warm up. He was in Class 9. The swimming classes of Class 9 and Class 11 have been in the same session since the second year of high school."Can I go into the water?" Chi Jiahan looked at the injury on Xu Ze's ribs and was a little worried."It's okay." "You won't say anything if something happens." Chi Jiahan stretched his arms high and said casually, "I just heard the physical education teacher said that your class's swimming class will be moved to Tuesday next week." Xu Ze didn't care about this, but he still asked: "Why?" "Just adjust the class, and then you will follow the same class... I forgot which other classes, we have classes together." Xu Ze was startled, and then slowly put his money in the deepThe eyes in the blue swimming pool turned to Chi Jiahan's face: "Class 1?" "Well, it should be so." Sensing that Xu Ze's attention suddenly became significantly concentrated, Chi Jiahan turned around and asked, "What's wrong?"Chi Jiahan is a good swimmer. In the past, Xu Ze would supervise his training after completing the task. But today, when Xu Ze came out of the water after training, Chi Jiahan found that his wounds had turned white.The physical education teacher recorded the data and looked up at Xu Ze with a hesitant expression. In the end, he didn't say anything and dismissed the get out of class.After all, Xu Ze's injuries always appeared one after another, and inquiries to him always yielded no results. The teachers at the preparatory school strictly followed the principle of not interfering in students' private lives. Over time, they could only turn a blind eye.An omega ran up to Xu Ze and said something to him. Xu Ze just looked down and then shook his head.Even with his knees, he knew that he must be saying "nothing" again. Chi Jiahan climbed ashore, walked over and pushed Xu Ze to the seat, asked him to sit down, and took an iodophor swab from the public medicine box on the side to disinfect him.Xu Ze didn't resist much the whole way, only saying: "It's healed, it won't be infected." Chi Jiahan almost laughed angrily at him: "It won't be infected, but those omegas will feel distressed." Xu Ze has always been slow in this regard - or he has never paid attention.He frowned: "What?" "It's okay. Don't go into the water later. I'll practice by myself. You can get off school early and rest." "You will be detained in class." Xu Ze was very clear about Chi Jiahan's swimming level.Chi Jiahan choked and then said, "I have made progress recently and can complete the training on time." "It's okay, let's go." Xu Ze casually pulled out a piece of gauze and pressed it on the wound and stood up, "I'm watching you from the shore." Back at the swimming pool, the atmosphere seemed different. Chi Jiahan looked forward and saw an alpha who was late for half the class standing at the edge of the next pool, surrounded by many omegas.The physical education teacher blew the whistle with a stopwatch, and the alpha simply entered the water - Chi Jiahan suspected that his entry position was enough for him to swim for several seconds."He Wei, S-level, transferred here last week, just came to class today." Chi Jiahan said, "I have a very good relationship with Lu Heyang." Lu Heyang's background has always been a mystery, and few people know about it, while He Wei is a transfer who has only been in for a short time, and no news was revealed before coming to the prep school. It is somewhat intriguing for the two of them to walk together - in the prep school, personal information can be kept completely confidential without being discovered, which is usually worth pondering.In Chi Jiahan's opinion, even if everyone in the school was guessing, Xu Ze would not be one of them.He seems to be apart from everyone, indifferent to everything - silent, not social or entertaining, you don't know what he cares about, what he likes, what desires he has. If the face on his head had been more ordinary, he would have been completely unknown on campus.However, Chi Jiahan still felt that as a friend, he had the obligation to educate Xu Ze on some interpersonal knowledge. Even though Xu Ze would never take the initiative to cause trouble, in the preparatory school, it would never go wrong to know more about him.

Xu Ze looked at the swimming pool at the other end and said "hmm", as usual, without making any comments.Chi Jiahan did make progress and completed today's training target five minutes before the end of get out of class. At the same time, He Wei completed all training tasks within fifteen minutes.Back in the locker room, He Wei took a shower. When he came out, Lu Heyang was sitting on the chair in front of the locker and looking at his phone.Hearing the footsteps, he raised his head: "Okay?" "Okay, thanks for your hard work, Mr. Lu came here to wait for me. Let's go and eat." The two of them walked out along the long corridor between the locker room and the bathroom. When they passed the door of the fourth locker room, an alpha suddenly walked out. He was wearing a black T-shirt that had been washed until it became a bit frayed. His hair was half wet, and the water droplets on the ends of the hair rolled into the collar along the white back of his neck.Xu Ze lowered his head and stopped at the door of the locker room, buckled his bracelet, and made way for the two alphas who were walking out.Unexpectedly, the two people did not pass by him. Xu Ze heard someone calling his name, and they called him word for word."Xu Ze." This tone sounded like he was trying to block someone. Xu Ze raised his head expressionlessly and looked over coldly, but was stunned for a moment.He Wei was smiling at him with the corner of his mouth raised: "The teacher told me that your training results today are the best among all alphas. Do you usually like swimming?" It was obviously He Wei who was asking him a question, but Xu Ze's eyes fell on Lu Heyang's face first.When he met that strange and calm gaze, Xu Ze's fingers curled up unconsciously and his bracelet fell to the ground."I don't like it." Xu Ze came to his senses, leaned over to pick up the bracelet, and replied in a low voice."That means you have good talent. Swimming class next week happens to be the midterm exam. Let's compete?" Xu Ze continued to buckle his bracelet, but somehow he couldn't buckle it properly. Finally, he simply gave up, dropped his hand and said, "Our class's swimming class will be moved to Tuesday." "Tuesday?" He Wei thought for a second, then turned to ask Lu Heyang, "It seems that your class's swimming class is on Tuesday?" "Yes." Lu Heyang responded."That's a coincidence. You two can compare." He Wei seems to be bored to death if he doesn't pick something to do.Lu Heyang didn't say anything and didn't seem to care much.He glanced at his phone: "Gu Yunchi said he was here and urged us to go over." "Tsk, when will his patience get better? Let's go." He Wei put his arm on Lu Heyang's shoulder and walked forward. When passing by Xu Ze, he said casually, "Please change your bracelet. It's too old, that's why it's so difficult to buckle." Xu Ze lowered his head slightly and didn't answer. After they left, he picked up the bracelet again.The corridor was dimly lit, and Xu Ze wore the bracelet for half a minute before fastening it.He hung his schoolbag on his left shoulder and walked out. A drop of water fell down his bangs and flowed into his right eye. His vision suddenly blurred in half. Xu Ze raised his hand to wipe his eyes.He didn't know why, but he felt a little annoyed."What do you want to do?" Lu Heyang suddenly asked on the way to the parking lot.He Wei pretended to be stupid: "What are you doing?" Lu Heyang looked at him."Are you talking about Xu Ze?" He Wei smiled, "I'm not doing anything, what's the matter with a few words?" "Why did you bring up the matter of changing the bracelet?" "It's really not malicious, I just mentioned it casually, I didn't think much about it." He Wei turned the car key, "My cousin, who used to be in the junior high school of the preparatory school, transferred last year, you know."I know.""This kid cried to me when she was in the third year of junior high and told me that she was rejected by a senior. I just remembered that he was that senior when I heard Xu Ze's name."He Wei said, sitting in the driver's seat, "So, I'm curious.""Don't be so boring in the future."One of He Wei's strengths is that he is full of curiosity, but his weakness is that his curiosity is never used where it should be used."They're all alphas. Don't make it look like I'm bullying him." He Wei started the car, "He's an S-class after all." Lu Heyang said lightly: "I'm afraid you'll cause trouble." "How could it be? I'm the most peaceful person." He Wei said without any shame., "It's you, I feel like Xu Ze is afraid of you. When you took one look, his bracelet fell to the ground." After he finished speaking, he asked Lu Heyang: "Did you notice it?" Lu Heyang took off the bracelet, hooked it on his finger, weighed it, and replied: "I didn't find it."
title_en: Recommended popular novels that have been completed
content_zh:
第一次开会，内容很简单，老师大致交代了后半个学期的一些安排，关于外出集训、听讲座、参加各类活动竞赛的事宜。许则坐在中间一排，看着大屏幕，但过程中总是不自觉垂下眼，望着前排座位出神——不过每次也只发一两秒的呆，他很快会回过神，重新看向讲台。结束前，老师将行程表发下来，活动大部分由学校出资组织，剩下一部分需要自费。顺着日期一行行字往下看，在看到自费活动后面跟着的价格时，许则的目光顿了顿，随后他把表格对折，放进校服口袋里。其他人陆陆续续离开会议室，老师在收拾东西，许则站起来，迈下台阶，走到讲台边。“有什么问题吗？”老师问。“老师，每个活动都必须参加吗？”“没有强制性要求，但建议都参加，对之后的录取方向和专业选择会有帮助。”与此同时，陆赫扬和贺蔚正往门边走，两人听见老师问了句：“是有什么不方便吗？”讲台前的alpha站得很直，顿了一秒，他说：“我想申请不参加。”陆赫扬抬眼，恰好看见许则的侧脸，片刻后，他从许则身后路过。贺蔚搭着陆赫扬的肩，很难讲贺少爷到底是不知人间疾苦还是在感叹，总之他低笑着自问自答说：“是有什么不方便吗？有啊~钞票不方便。”下午最后一节是游泳课，许则从更衣室出来，池嘉寒正站在泳池边热身，他是九班的，九班和十一班的游泳课从高二开始就是同一节。“能下水吗？”池嘉寒看了眼许则肋骨上的伤，多少有些担心。“没事。”“有事你也不会说的。”池嘉寒高高地抻长手臂，随口道，“刚刚我听见体育老师说你们班下周起游泳课换到星期二了。”许则对此并不关心，但他还是问：“为什么？”“就是调课吧，之后你们就跟一班……还有哪几个班我忘了，一起上课。”许则一怔，随后很慢地把投在深蓝色泳池里的目光转到池嘉寒脸上：“一班？”“嗯，应该是的。”察觉许则的注意力忽然有了明显的集中，池嘉寒扭过头问，“怎么了？”许则摇了一下头：“没什么。”哨声响起，两人各自回到alpha和omega的队伍里，体育老师开始安排训练任务，完成的人可以提早下课。池嘉寒是游泳苦手，以往许则都会在任务达标后来监督他训练，但今天许则训练完从水里上来，池嘉寒发现他的伤口已经泛白。体育老师做好数据记录，抬头看了许则一眼，表情有些犹豫，最终还是什么都没说，让他下课了。毕竟许则身上的伤向来层出不穷，向他询问也总是无果，预备校的老师又严格遵循不干涉学生私生活的准则，久而久之，便只能报以视若无睹的态度。有omega跑到许则面前，对他说了什么，许则只低头看了看，接着摇摇头。用膝盖想都知道他肯定又在说‘没事’，池嘉寒爬上岸，走过去推着许则往座椅边走，让他坐下，从一旁的公用药箱里拿了碘伏棉签帮他消毒。许则一路都没怎么反抗，只说：“已经愈合了，不会感染的。”池嘉寒几乎要被他气笑：“不会感染，但那些omega会心疼。”许则在这方面一直迟钝得可以——又或是从没留意过。他皱起眉：“什么？”“没什么，等会儿你不要下水了，我自己练，你早点放学休息。”“你会被留堂的。”许则对池嘉寒的游泳水平很清楚。池嘉寒噎了下，才说：“我最近进步了，能按时完成训练的。”“没事，走吧。”许则随手抽了张纱布按在伤口上，站起来，“我在岸边看着你。”回到泳池边，气氛似乎有所不同，池嘉寒往前看，见有个迟到了半节课的alpha正站在隔壁池边，身旁围着不少omega。体育老师掐着秒表吹哨，alpha干脆地入了水——池嘉寒怀疑他的入水位置就够自己游好几秒的了。“贺蔚，s级，上星期转来的，今天刚来上课。”池嘉寒说，“跟陆赫扬关系很好。”陆赫扬的背景一直是个谜，鲜少人知道，而贺蔚是个转学进来不过半天的生面孔，在来预备校前没被透露出任何风声，两人走在一起，多少有些耐人寻味——在预备校里，个人信息能完全保密不被查到半点的，通常值得深思。在池嘉寒看来，就算全校人都在猜，许则也不会是其中之一。他好像游离在所有人之外，对任何事都漠不关心——沉默寡言，不社交不娱乐，你不知道他在乎什么，喜欢什么，有什么欲望，如果他脑袋上的那张脸长得再普通一些，完全会是淹没在校园里籍籍无名的一位。不过池嘉寒还是觉得，作为朋友，有义务向许则稍稍科普些人际知识，即便许则绝不可能主动惹事，但在预备校里，多了解一点总是不会错的。

许则看着那头的泳池，“嗯”了一声，如同往常一样，没发表任何意见。池嘉寒确实进步了，在下课前五分钟完成了今天的训练指标，同时，贺蔚则是在十五分钟内结束了所有训练任务。回到更衣室，贺蔚冲了个澡，出来时陆赫扬正坐在储物柜前的椅子上看手机。听到脚步声，他抬起头：“好了？”“好了，辛苦陆公子专程来这儿等我。走，吃饭去了。”两人顺着更衣室和浴室之间的长廊往外走，路过第四号更衣室门口时，里面忽然走出来一个alpha，身上穿了件洗到有些磨毛发白的黑T，头发半湿，发尾上的水珠沿着白皙的后颈滚进领口里。许则低着头停在更衣室门口，扣手环，顺便给正在往外走的两个alpha让路。不料那两人却并没有从他面前路过，许则听见有人叫他的名字，并且是以那种，一字一句的叫法。“许、则。”这语气听起来像是来堵人的，许则面无表情地抬起头，冷冷看过去，却瞬间怔了怔。贺蔚正勾着嘴角朝他笑：“老师跟我说，你今天的训练成绩是所有alpha里最好的，你平常喜欢游泳？”明明是贺蔚在问他问题，许则的目光却首先落在陆赫扬脸上。在撞上那道陌生又平静的视线时，许则的手指无意识蜷缩了一下，手环掉在了地上。“不喜欢。”许则回过神，俯身去捡手环，低声回答。“那说明你天赋好，下星期游泳课刚好是期中考，我们比一场？”许则继续扣他的手环，但不知怎的，始终扣不准，最后他干脆放弃，手垂下去，说：“我们班游泳课以后调到周二。”“周二？”贺蔚想了一秒，转头问陆赫扬，“你们一班的游泳课好像是在周二来着？”“嗯。”陆赫扬应了声。“那也巧，你俩可以比比看。”贺蔚这人好像不挑点事就会无聊死。陆赫扬没搭话，不怎么在意的样子。他看了眼手机：“顾昀迟说他到了，催我们过去。”“啧，他的耐性什么时候能好一点，走了走了。”贺蔚搭住陆赫扬的肩往前走，路过许则面前时，他顺口道，“你的手环换个吧，太旧了，所以才这么难扣。”许则微微低着头，没作答，等他们走后，他再次拿起手环。走廊光线昏暗，许则戴了足足有半分钟，才把手环扣好。他将书包挂到左肩，往外走，一滴水珠顺着刘海落下来，流进右眼，视野顿时模糊了一半，许则抬手擦了下眼睛。不知道为什么，他觉得有些懊恼。“你想干什么。”去停车场的路上，陆赫扬忽然问。贺蔚装傻：“什么干什么？”陆赫扬看他一眼。“你说许则啊？”贺蔚笑了笑，“我又没干嘛，聊两句怎么了。”“为什么提换手环的事。”“真的没恶意，就随口一提，没想那么多。”贺蔚转着车钥匙，“我堂妹，以前在预备校初中部的，去年转学走了，你知道吧？”“知道。”“这小孩，初三的时候跟我哭诉说她向一个学长告白被拒绝了，今天听到许则的名字我才想起来，他就是那个学长。”贺蔚说着，坐上驾驶座，“所以，我好奇嘛。”“以后别那么无聊了。”陆赫扬说。贺蔚的优点之一是充满好奇心，缺点是他的好奇心从来不用在该用的地方。“都是alpha，你别弄得好像我欺负他一样。”贺蔚发动车子，“他好歹是个s级啊。”陆赫扬淡淡道：“怕你惹事。”“怎么会，我这人最安分了。”贺蔚大言不惭，“倒是你，我感觉许则好像很怕你，被你看一眼，手环都掉地上了。”他说完还问陆赫扬：“你发现了吗？”陆赫扬摘下手环，勾在手指上掂了掂，回答：“没发现。”
